phase-3.title: Build
phase-3.text: For each work item the script serves test-spec, baseline, test-author, test-red, implement, test-green and test-refine in order. A revise outcome returns through the script for a replan.

phase-4.title: Prove
phase-4.text: Regression, documentation, skill assessment and validation, and static checks each run as a script-served stage with their own result file.

phase-5.title: Integrate
phase-5.text: The script integrates verified work and re-verifies the integrated result before the next item.
